purpose: Development validation of the explicitly adapted CF2 baseline against the current support-search variants, not final held-out evaluation.
query_comparison: Methods within each run share queries, frozen checkpoint, candidate region and achieved undirected-edge budgets. These query samples were drawn anew; their aggregate results are not paired comparisons with earlier 100-query runs.
baseline_scope: CF2 uses the paper probability-margin objective with binary links, fixed features, tied undirected masks, normalization-aware candidates and external top-B discretization. Original node-explainer optimization defaults are starting settings, not a tuned link-task baseline.
timing_context: The two runs executed concurrently on the same RTX 4090, also shared with desktop processes. Recorded ranking times are diagnostic and must not be treated as controlled comparative runtime evidence.
verification: All 1200 saved rows have finite intervention logits and support sizes matching their recorded effective budgets. Source hashes were checked against the current files. The separate audit checks recorded swap-search non-regression, not statistical significance or independent model re-execution.
interpretation: The necessity/sufficiency trade-off varies across data sets and budgets. Coarse grouping has not demonstrated a stable independent advantage over ungrouped swaps. Both favorable and unfavorable results are retained. No manuscript numerical results were replaced.
